name: zhida-codex
description: Connect Codex to Zhida with device authorization for evidence-based knowledge and keyword edits.

interface.shortDescription: Optimize Zhida knowledge bases from real support traces.
interface.longDescription: Zhida Codex uses a local bridge and OAuth device authorization to connect Codex without a localhost callback. It can inspect conversations and retrieval traces, search knowledge base or keyword entries, and apply reviewed direct edits after confirmation.
defaultPrompt: Find the refund knowledge entry and update its answer.
Add a keyword rule for refund status questions.
Analyze recent Zhida replies and propose knowledge changes.
Inspect this request_id and explain the retrieval trace.
Preview a knowledge or keyword changeset for these fixes.
